newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay cotton steady, mill buying sluggish.
newsitem.headline: Bombay cotton steady, mill buying sluggish.

text.p: Bombay cotton prices held steady in a narrow trading range, with mill buying still sluggish and supplies limited, dealers said on Thursday.
The spot market was quiet, with Bengal-deshi at 1,005/1,075 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) and Punjab saw-ginned at 1,820/1,855 per maund.
In the Gujarat segment, Kalyan cotton was steady at 14,100/14,700 rupees per candy (355.56 kg), as were Kala-ginned at 12,300/12,400 and wagad at 13,000/13,100.
One broker said inflows were low because the season was coming to an end.
"Supplies of cotton...to the Bombay market also remained at a low ebb because widespread rain in the producing centres has disrupted the transportation of cotton," he said.
